cd /workspace && python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
W='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
targets=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('word/') and (n.endswith('document.xml') or 'header' in n or 'footer' in n)]
alltoks=set()
for n in targets:
    d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
    root=ET.fromstring(d)
    # reconstruct text per paragraph
    for p in root.iter(W+'p'):
        texts=[]
        for t in p.iter(W+'t'):
            texts.append(t.text or '')
        full=''.join(texts)
        toks=re.findall(r'[A-Z][A-Z_]{3,}',full)
        for tk in toks:
            alltoks.add((n,tk))
for n,tk in sorted(alltoks):
    print(n, tk)
EOF

cd /workspace && python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile,re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
W='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
def paras(n):
    root=ET.fromstring(z.read(n))
    out=[]
    for p in root.iter(W+'p'):
        txt=''.join((t.text or '') for t in p.iter(W+'t'))
        out.append(txt)
    return out
for n in ['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/footer1.xml','word/header4.xml','word/footer4.xml']:
    print('====',n)
    for t in paras(n):
        if t.strip():
            print('  |',repr(t))
# leftover check across all parts
print('--- leftover scan ---')
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        s=z.read(n).decode('utf-8',errors='ignore')
        txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',s)
        if '{{' in txt or 'IF_RELOCATION' in txt:
            print('LEFTOVER in',n, re.findall(r'\{\{[^}]*\}\}|IF_RELOCATION',txt))
print('done')
EOF
